implementation_notes: Before any completed export, align method IDs to saved-map official suffixes and retain raw medians separately from intervals gated by block support; original protocol and simulation freeze unchanged
interval_policy: Reuse independently audited historical block-resampling intervals; descriptive only; no inference after learned-map selection is calibrated
grid_policy: Expand declared saved-map grid; retain absent maps and absent anchor-effect rows as non-evaluable; keep historical-row indicator for denominator reconciliation

aggregation.method_resolution_within_section: Median of eligible alternative partitions; reference reported separately
aggregation.section: Median across method-resolution summaries with equal weight; available settings only; report counts and ranges
aggregation.patient: Median across eligible section summaries with equal weight; report section ranges; no pooled section bootstrap interval
aggregation.cohort: Separate resources; patient counts and observed patient distributions; no population prevalence confidence interval
aggregation.recurrence: Patient indicators are descriptive presence summaries; they do not test recurrence or prevalence

geometry_reporting.identical: Selected tumor/stroma domains and near/far groups are identical to reference
geometry_reporting.adjacency_only: Selected stromal domain is unchanged, far groups are identical, and near groups change under strict adjacency
geometry_reporting.disjoint_stromal_domains: Selected stromal domains share zero registered spots; report compartment replacement separately
geometry_reporting.other: Report Jaccard overlaps, changed spots outside fixed anchor bands, and centroid distance without attributing boundary motion
